steps.leftScale: The left hand plays the {cScale} with the fingers in the opposite order: 5 4 3 2 1, then the middle finger crosses over the thumb to {a}, and 2 1 to the top.
steps.crossOver: The tricky part: from {e}, play 3 2 1, cross 3 over to {a}, and come back with the thumb passing under to {g}.
steps.up: The whole scale going up with the left hand.
